question: abiasaph is recorded with more than one father: korah-3, elkanah.
note: EXO 6:24 lists Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph as Korah’s sons, while the repeated Hebrew בְנוֹ in 1CH 6:22–23 presents Assir → Elkanah → Ebiasaph → Assir. These are differing genealogical presentations; 1CH 6:37 also calls Ebiasaph son of Korah, so the supplied texts do not justify changing the rows or splitting the record.
